priorityList: Never use the same offensive ability twice in a row to maintain your Mastery: Combo Strikes.
Cast Invoke Xuen the White Tiger on cooldown, ideally when Zenith is ready or the target will live at least 25 seconds.
Cast Zenith while Xuen is active or during Bloodlust to maximize Coalescence and Vitality generation.
Cast Celestial Conduit while the Zenith buff is active, ideally when your main strikes (RSK and FoF) are on cooldown.
Cast Whirling Dragon Punch as soon as it becomes available (requires both Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury to be on cooldown).
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, especially while Heart of the Jade Serpent or Zenith buffs are active.
Cast Rising Sun Kick on cooldown as your primary Chi spender.
Cast Fists of Fury on cooldown, or immediately if you reach 30 stacks of Flurry Charge.
Cast Touch of Death on targets below 15% health (or to execute) unless Zenith is currently active.
Cast Spinning Crane Kick only when the Dance of Chi-Ji proc is active.
Cast Blackout Kick if you have a Combo Breaker proc or if you need to spend excess Chi to avoid overcapping.
Cast Tiger Palm to generate Chi only if you have 3 or less Chi and are nearing maximum Energy.
Cast Slicing Winds as a high-priority filler if available.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racial abilities during your Xuen or Zenith windows for maximum burst impact.
